data.exact_reserve_text: The claims development table shows the 2021 underwriting year's cumulative gross claims incurred estimate decreased from 5,817 $'000 (Two Years Later) to 3,428 $'000 (Current estimate), representing a release of 2,389 $'000.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a release of 2.389 million USD in prior year reserves, primarily driven by favorable development on the 2021 underwriting year as indicated by the claims development table. This contributes to profits earning through from prior years, with general factors like claim costs, inflation, market factors, and judicial decisions influencing estimates.
raw_causal_phrases: the profits are earning through from prior years
future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience
average claim costs, claim handling costs, claim inflation factors and claim numbers

one-off occurrence; changes in market factors such as public attitude to claiming: economic conditions: as well as internal factors such as portfolio mix, policy conditions and claims handling procedures
variation in interest rates, delays in settlement and changes in foreign currency rates
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle for the 2021 underwriting year, as no explicit prior year movement note was found. The gross premium mix was taken from the Managing Agent's report as the segmental analysis note did not provide a detailed breakdown by line of business.
